class.name: OpenWorldTreeVariant
class.brief_description: Meshes and distance settings for one pre-generated tree variation.
class.description: [OpenWorldTreeVariant] describes one baked tree variation with up to three LOD meshes. Missing LOD meshes fall back to an available more detailed mesh. Instances beyond [member max_distance] are culled. Collision values are metadata for gameplay or editor tools; [OpenWorldTree3D] does not create physics bodies automatically.

method.name: get_lod_index_for_distance
method.description: Returns the available LOD index for [param distance], or [code]-1[/code] when the tree should be culled or has no mesh.

method.name: get_lod_mesh
method.description: Returns the mesh assigned to LOD index 0, 1, or 2.

members.member: Suggested height in meters for a simplified trunk collision shape.
